title: Senior Data Engineer- Data & AI Platform (f/m/d)
description: Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) The Essentials Team: Data & Analytics Start date: As soon as possible Location: Berlin / Genoa, hybrid — at least 60% in the office Contract: Fixed-term Working language: English Salary band: Shared before your first interview Your Impact As Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) at 7NXT Health Group, you’ll own our data platform end to end — from consuming backend events and APIs to the metrics a stakeholder reads. You’ll work closely with backend engineering, product and the business, and report to the Head of Data & Analytics. Your work directly impacts the data foundation on which ~900,000 subscribers across nine European markets rely every day. We automate anything that repeats. Stakeholders used to ask us “is this number right?” — now they query governed data themselves through our MCP servers and a Slack agent. It’s the part of the job we’re proudest of, and you’ll keep shaping it as a product. What you’ll drive You design, build, test and maintain scalable, reliable and secure data pipelines and architectures You keep integrations healthy as backend teams change their schemas, so the business keeps one version of each number it can defend You ingest new data sources with Airflow and dbt, and lead migrations and KPI restatements when definitions change You develop the governed semantic layer and data catalog across our brands — 7Mind, Gymondo and Buddyfit You build Customer 360 and other cross-brand data products that help teams understand their users You turn tracking knowledge into a tracking plan as code, so every event can be validated against a shared definition You model data around the decisions the business makes, so every KPI traces back to a clear definition You keep BigQuery fast and affordable as data volume grows You collaborate closely with backend engineering, product and the business, and actively shape how we work Our stack: BigQuery · GCS · dbt · Airflow · Python · SQL · GitHub Actions · Cloud Run · Rudderstack · GA4 · Firebase · Tableau · Claude Code · MCP servers · Slack bots What defines you Must-have 4+ years building and running a production data warehouse in an industry context Strong SQL and Python, with dbt and BigQuery in depth Hands-on experience with GCP (BigQuery, GCS) or comparable cloud services Airflow or a similar orchestrator; experience ingesting from application databases and third-party APIs ETL/ELT concepts and experience writing tests that support data governance At least one migration where the upstream system changed and the numbers still had to match Git, CI/CD, and comfort with Bash and Linux scripting Daily use of coding agents and opinions on how to make them reliable Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences; fluent English Nice-to-have Master’s in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering) LLM tools built on top of data — MCP servers, agents or bots Subscription and payment data (Chargebee, Adyen, app receipts, vouchers) Event tracking design and governance (GTM, tracking plans, schema validation) Marketing attribution and CRM data (Braze, GA4, Adjust) Container-based environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and Terraform Tableau or comparable visualisation tools People who make things happen 7NXT Health Group is Europe’s leading platform group for digital fitness and mental wellbeing. Through our brands Gymondo, 7Mind, Buddyfit and Preneo, we reach 20–30 million people per month across 9 European markets, helping them live healthier lives — physically and mentally. Our team of ~170 people grows organically, works at eye level, and genuinely practises what we preach. We believe in trust over rigid structures, smart working over endless meetings — and that sustainability, inclusion and diversity aren’t buzzwords, they’re how we actually operate. Everyone counts We welcome what makes you unique. At 7NXT Health Group we believe in diversity, openness and team spirit. No matter which gender you identify with, whether you have a disability, what your neurotype is, where you come from, what you believe in or how you love — you are welcome here. Don’t meet all the criteria? No problem — if you’d like to help shape the future of health & wellbeing with us, we look forward to your application. Need a more accessible process or have questions? Write to us — we’ll find a way. Skip the cover letter. Show us one business process you automated or simplified — the one you’re most proud of. A repo, a script, a write-up or a few sentences are all fine. Tell us what it replaced and what you learned. We’ll go through it together in the interview.
